headline: Magic Carpet flies like the original again
lede: The 1994 Bullfrog god-game was rebuilt much closer to its source: pearls now trail your carpet as a carried load you must fly home to the vault, die and it spills; fireballs and lightning crater the terrain itself and burn villages; and three worlds — Verdant Isles, Emberwild, Frostbound — stand between you and equilibrium.

notes.text: MAGIC CARPET rework shipped (#1041, PR #1059): bank-by-delivery economy, spell-cratered terrain that floods below sea level, three worlds with rising quotas and hoarding wizards, spells learned across worlds.
carpetcheck grew 24→30 checks: delivery vs carry, death spills, crater deformation ×2, hut burn-to-rubble, mana conservation rebased across worlds — mutation-proven; autopilot clears 60/60 seeds.
Wolves only reach a carpet flying low, giants keep their distance from your castle, and respawn brings you home high and shielded — altitude is armor now.
jalfern.com's outer proxy cache was still serving the previous bundle at shift end; the Vercel deploy completed and the edge self-heals (same pattern as #1040).
